# Grégoire Darcy

> PhD candidate in cognitive science at Institut Jean Nicod (ENS-PSL): trust, social norms, narrative preferences, misinformation. Author of La désinformation (2026). Teaches cognitive science applied to public policy, strategic affairs, and cognitive warfare at ENS-PSL, Paris-Dauphine, Sciences Po Paris, and the École de Guerre. Normalien (ENS Rennes, Promotion 2020, ranked 1st at national entrance exam). Writes policy briefs for the French Presidency on disinformation and STEM gender gaps.

## Research Areas
- Formation of narrative, moral, and political beliefs and preferences
- Trust, Cooperation, and Social Norms
- Psychology of Misinformation and Disinformation
- Psychology and Public Policies
- Cognitive and Behavioral Approaches to Law and Regulation
- Cognitive Warfare and Counter-Propaganda
- Experimental Jurisprudence

- Dubourg, E., Thouzeau, V., Freynet, R., Darcy, G., Beuchot, T., Noël, N., Chevallier, C., & Baumard, N. (under review). Personality structure predicts story preferences across 23 countries. - Darcy, G., Baumard, N., André, J.-B., & Chevallier, C. (in preparation). Naive Theories of Human Nature: How Folk Beliefs about Human Behavior Shape Policy Preferences among French Citizens.

## Theatre
Writer and resident actor for mock literary trials at Théâtre de Poche-Montparnasse (2024–present, 10+ performances). Repertoire: Le Procès de la Panthère des neiges, Le Procès des Piliers de la mer (with Sylvain Tesson), Le Procès d'Antigone (as Creon), Le Procès de Tristan et Iseult (as Tristan, with Michel Zink), Le Procès de La Fontaine (as prosecutor).
